Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 1013) to amend the Federal securities laws to enhance 403(b) plans, and for other purposes.

action.text: The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-878, by Mr. Griffith.
Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 1013 with 1 hour of general debate. Previous question shall be considered as ordered except motion to recommit. Bill is closed to amendments.

calendar.text: Placed on the House Calendar, Calendar No. 92.

action.text: DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H. Res. 1650.

POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on H. Res. 1650, the Chair put the question on ordering the previous question and by voice vote, announced that the ayes had prevailed. Mr. McGovern demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.
On ordering the previous question Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: 213 - 207 (Roll no. 318).

vote.text: On agreeing to the resolution Agreed to by recorded vote: 215 - 209 (Roll no. 319).

action.text: Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
